title: Submit a contact inquiry successfully
description: This verifies that a potential client can complete and submit the contact form and see a success confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Fill in the first name field with a valid first name
Fill in the last name field with a valid last name
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Fill in the message field with a valid inquiry message
Submit the form
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the contact form is no longer shown

title: Navigate across the main public pages on desktop
description: This verifies that a visitor can use the desktop navigation to reach each main public page and that the selected page renders successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to view the About page
Click the link to view the advisory services page
Click the link to view the investment intelligence page
Click the link to view the track record page
Click the link to view the transactions page
Click the link to view the insights page
Verify the selected public pages render successfully

title: Navigate between pages using the mobile menu
description: This verifies that a mobile visitor can open the navigation menu, move to another public page, and close the menu successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the mobile navigation menu
Click the link to view the About page
Close the mobile navigation menu
Verify the About page renders successfully
Verify the mobile navigation menu is closed

title: View home page statistics and summaries
description: A visitor can land on the home page and see the firm’s key statistics and summary content that establish trust.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify key statistics are displayed
Verify summary content is displayed

title: Navigate through the public site from the home page
description: A visitor can move from the home page to the main public pages using site navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to view the about page
Verify the about page content is displayed
Click the link to view the advisory services page
Verify the advisory services content is displayed
Click the link to view the investment intelligence page
Verify the investment intelligence content is displayed

title: Filter transactions by asset class
description: This verifies that selecting an asset class filter updates the transaction evidence table to show matching results.

steps.description: Navigate to /transactions
Select an asset class filter
Verify the transactions table updates to matching results

title: View track record charts and performance details
description: A visitor can open the track record page, scroll to the chart section, and inspect chart details that appear on hover.

steps.description: Navigate to /track-record
Scroll to render the track record charts
Hover over a data point in the performance chart
Verify track record performance details are displayed
Verify chart visuals are displayed

title: Filter transactions by geography
description: This verifies that selecting a geography filter updates the transaction evidence table to show matching results.

steps.description: Navigate to /transactions
Select a geography filter
Verify the transactions table updates to matching results

title: Combine transaction filters to narrow results
description: This verifies that applying both asset class and geography filters narrows the transaction evidence table correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to /transactions
Select an asset class filter
Select a geography filter
Verify the transactions table updates to combined filtered results

title: Show validation errors on an empty contact form
description: This verifies that the contact form blocks submission and shows validation feedback when all required fields are left empty.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Submit the form
Verify validation errors are visible
Verify the form remains available

title: Reject an invalid email in the contact form
description: This verifies that the contact form shows validation feedback when the email field is not in a valid format.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Fill in the first name field with a valid first name
Fill in the last name field with a valid last name
Fill in the email field with an invalid email format
Fill in the message field with a valid inquiry message
Submit the form
Verify email validation errors are visible
Verify the form is not submitted

title: Browse the investment intelligence page
description: A visitor can open the investment intelligence page and review the firm’s investment themes and macro analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /investment-intelligence
Verify investment themes are displayed
Verify macro analysis content is displayed

title: View firm background and methodology
description: A visitor can open the About page and review the firm’s methodology and team information.

steps.description: Navigate to /about
Verify firm methodology content is displayed
Verify team information is displayed

title: Open the insights library article grid
description: A visitor can open the insights library and view the research article grid.

steps.description: Navigate to /insights
Verify an article grid is displayed

title: View advisory service offerings
description: A visitor can open the Advisory Services page and review the firm’s service detail cards.

steps.description: Navigate to /advisory-services
Verify advisory service detail cards are displayed
Verify service descriptions are displayed

title: Review the firm background and methodology from insights
description: A research-driven visitor can move through the public site to understand the firm’s background and methodology after browsing research content.

steps.description: Navigate to /insights
Click the link to view the about page
Verify firm methodology content is displayed
Click the link to view the advisory services page
Verify team or services detail content is displayed
